briefTitle: Phase 1/2 Trial of S241656 in Selected RAS/MAPK Mutation- Positive Malignancies

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Life expectancy of ≥ 12 weeks in the opinion of the investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Histologically or cytologically confirmed recurrent locally advanced (unresectable) or metastatic solid tumors with documented RAS or RAF mutations or alterations.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General RAS or RAF mutations span multiple genes without a single typed check like kras_status or braf_status.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior use of experimental agents that target the KRAS/BRAF/MEK/ERK pathway.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion refers to a broad pathway of experimental agents rather than a specific typed drug or class.
